{{Removed|date = 29th of October 2020}} {{AttributeInfobox |image1 = ShieldAttrIcon.png |type = Status Effect |effects = Damage Limit
Shields }} ==Description== '''Shield''' was a status effect that gave the enemy shields, which set a damage limit to an enemy. ==Mechanics== '''Shield''' was an attribute that was mainly applied with abilities. It made four shields appear around the enemy, which made the enemy limit most forms of damage to whatever the quoted number on the shields. Exceptions were: *All forms of damage from [[units]], including collision and ranged (for example, the [[Golden Mafia]] and [[Railgun Tank]]). *Bee damage from the [[Swarmer]]. *Burn damage from the [[Pyromancer]]. *[[Splash Damage]]. ==Enemy List== The following enemies could perform ''Shield Immunity'': *[[Templar]] (''Permanent Shield'', maximum 2 damage) *[[Summoner Boss]] (''Summon'', maximum 2 to 4 damage) *[[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] (Legacy version, ''Summon'', ''Rage Mode'', maximum 3 damage) *[[Nuclear Fallen King]] (''Rage Mode'', maximum 3 damage) *[[Sir Hopsalot]] ([[Eggy Island]], ''Shield'', maximum 2 damage) ==Trivia== *While '''Shield''' has been removed from the game, the visual effects applied by it were not. Because of this, due to bugs, enemies can still have them appear, though regardless of what the damage is listed on them the damage will not be reduced. **The [[Fallen Titan]] currently displays a ''Shield'' of 40, though it does not reduce damage at all. *The [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] attribute can be considered a successor to '''Shield''', though unlike it, [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] does not have a visual indicator, has less ways to bypass it and only reduces damage to one instead of any amount. ==Update History== *'''4 March 2020''' - [[Release v1.8|Release v1.8.0]] **'''Shield''' added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Shield''' removed. {{AttributeNavBox}}
